name: Dial Turn
description: The first clip whips off to the left with a growing horizontal motion blur, then the second clip swings in like a dial turning around the bottom centre, overshoots and settles with a springy wobble and a rotational blur. Recreation of the CapCut "Dial Turn" transition. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.
